title: Merkavah mystics' chariot practice on Yom Kippur

tellings.quote: process is possible. I mean every every year during Yam Kapour is the time when certain groups of Jewish mystics then will then descend the chariot.

plain: Every year on Yom Kippur, the Jewish Day of Atonement, certain groups of Jewish mystics carry out what they call "descending the chariot", a visionary journey from the Merkavah tradition, an old Jewish practice built around visions of God's heavenly chariot. A writer on secret and occult history named Peter Levenda describes this, without naming a source, as proof that such a journey of the mind is possible.
